description: This file defines a Java class 'HttpOverrideForwardedRequestToJavaSerializer' that serializes 'HttpOverrideForwardedRequest' objects into Java code strings, including handling nested serialization of request/response overrides and modifiers, as well as delays.

classes.name: HttpOverrideForwardedRequestToJavaSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class that converts HttpOverrideForwardedRequest objects into Java code strings with proper indentation and nested serialization.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes an HttpOverrideForwardedRequest object into a Java code string, handling nested request/response overrides, modifiers, and delays with indentation.

methods.name: appendNewLineAndIndent
methods.description: Appends a newline and a specified number of spaces for indentation to the StringBuffer.
